subject.labeling_verbatim: SETTLED_OK and COMPENSATED are deterministic arithmetic/policy judgments over caller-attested inputs: actual_settled_krw is caller-reported (not re-read from chain state); the server holds no wallet and escrows no funds (holdback_krw is caller-declared); every verdict is offline-recomputable from inputs plus quote_hash. At rule_version 0.2.0 an overpayment (delta < 0) is its own state: OVERPAID, compensated_krw=0, uncovered_krw=0, credit_delta=0; 0.1.0 (also the default when the field is omitted) runs the frozen legacy engine byte for byte — an overpayment falls through to SETTLED_OK, credit_delta +5. This seal asserts run validity and finding completeness, not on-chain finality.

recon_facts.R3_trial_mechanics_v02: quota 3 POST per X-Trial-Client id (409 consumes a call, 422 validation does not — 0029 observation); trial judgments are persisted to the durable ledger (backend blob, durable true per /health recon 2026-11-24T04:31:40Z) only when persist_receipt is true, tier=trial; GET /v1/ledger reads are free (author spec)
recon_facts.R4_receipt_mechanics_verbatim: record written with a receipt, no receipt or a wrong one -> 403 RECEIPT_REQUIRED; unknown idempotency_key -> 404 LEDGER_NOT_FOUND; correct receipt -> 200 with receipt_verified: true and recomputation.match + ledger_hash_match. Precedence for 'unknown key without receipt' is not specified: expected 404 per the author's wording; a 403 would be recorded honestly as a check-order fact, not a failure
recon_facts.R5_overpayment_split_verbatim: author (comment 7097154364, checked live on identical payloads expected 50000 actual 60000): 0.1.0 -> SETTLED_OK +5; 0.2.0 -> OVERPAID 0. A0.7 reproduces this independently on a fresh trial id
recon_facts.R6_credit_table: per 0029 (observed mapping, formula not published): +5 SETTLED_OK; -5 COMPENSATED with uncovered_krw=0; -17 COMPENSATED with uncovered_krw>0; 0 PENDING_RECONCILIATION and OVERPAID. COMPENSATED math: compensated_krw = min(holdback_krw, delta), uncovered_krw = max(0, delta - compensated_krw)
